name: execute-milestone-ledger-status-review
title: Execute the milestone ledger status review and hardening plan (M0-M7)
description: Story B-9051 delivered docs/requirements/decisions/milestone-ledger-status-review-and-hardening-plan.md but only authored the plan document; all 8 milestones and 43 sub-objectives are still in planned status. This story executes the truth-first document review itself: it audits whether the existing milestone_ledger_set/add/get, milestone_status, and milestone_closeout implementation matches the intended safety boundary, records per-milestone finding-or-pass outcomes in a findings report, updates the plan milestone statuses, and closes with an explicit M7 decision (clean pass or a bounded follow-up story proposal).
